title: Consonants and the Yogh
subtitle: Ch, j, th, v, z — French influence and the yogh survives.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: Ch = 'ch' as in church. J = 'j' as in judge (new from French). Th = 'th' voiced or unvoiced. V and F distinguished (Old English had only F). Yogh (ȝ) = 'y' or guttural 'gh.' The letter thorn (þ) disappears; scribes use 'th' instead. Spelling is inconsistent across manuscripts.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Consonants and the Yogh.
